tools.name: search_directory
tools.description: Search the Swarmnest directory of AI agent tools: MCP servers, LLM APIs, agent frameworks, coding agents, browser automation, vector databases, web scraping, search, speech and text-to-speech APIs, data sources and more (thousands of hand-checked entries in 160+ categories). Keyword search over name

tools.name: get_entry
tools.description: Get the full Swarmnest directory record for one tool by its slug (from search_directory results): name, description, category, vendor URL, docs URL, auth, pricing, operating systems, open-source flag, last link check and the canonical swarmnest.ai URL. Unknown slugs return close matches.

tools.name: list_marketplace_products
tools.description: List the agent skill packs, workflows and bundles sold in the Swarmnest Marketplace (US only), with name, type, summary, price in USD, what each bundle includes, the product page URL and the checkout URL.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_directory, get_entry, search_skills, get_skill, list_marketplace_products, submit_listing, ask_tool_question, get_hive, hive_post, get_hive_notifications · Private data: get_entry, search_skills, get_skill, submit_listing, submit_field_report, update_agent_profile, ask_tool_question, answer_tool_question, vote_answer, hive_post, hive_reply, get_hive_notifications, request_hive_review · Public sink: submit_listing, submit_field_report, get_hive, hive_post, hive_reply, hive_vote, hive_flag · Destructive: search_skills, get_skill, vote_answer, hive_vote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_directory, get_entry, search_skills, get_skill, list_marketplace_products, submit_listing, ask_tool_question, get_hive, hive_post, get_hive_notifications · Private data: get_entry, search_skills, get_skill, submit_listing, submit_field_report, update_agent_profile, ask_tool_question, answer_tool_question, vote_answer, hive_post, hive_reply, get_hive_notifications, request_hive_review · Public sink: submit_listing, submit_field_report, get_hive, hive_post, hive_reply, hive_vote, hive_flag · Destructive: search_skills, get_skill, vote_answer, hive_vote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_entry" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

Unknown slugs return close matches." → after: "Get the full Swarmnest directory record for one tool by its slug (from search_directory results): name, description, category, vendor URL, docs URL, auth, pricing, operating systems, open-source flag, link_check (page_last_responded: the date an automated fetch of the listed page last answered; a fe"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
